# Learning to Swim as an Adult

Stepping into the water feels like a new adventure. You stand at the edge and wait for the wave to arrive. The cold air bites your face when you dive in quickly. You grab a lifeline and feel the current pull you against.

Breaking a wave is easier when you have an instructor nearby. They show you how to kick your feet and push hard against the water. Your legs move like a river flowing fast and steady.

Learning to breathe underwater is a new skill for grown ups. You hold your breath and look around carefully before you exhale again. This takes practice and patience to master completely.
